book.name: Jon
book.title: JON Kamambuno Wakai Jon muno boglkwa

content: Maria eremogl Yesus kagle kungo ere tongwa
Pasova ninaglkwa ande enge 6 paimoglko, Yesus ende Betani kamun ongwa. Igle Lasarus dumomo ana ye goglko Yesus aglendi ikor endungwa yagle ikra.
Ye eremogl Yesus gunyei tendre, ana pokndungo kaiya moknamo igle akekun eriko ana Marta suro tongwa. Yesus ya yomba bogl meglmara igle Lasarus suna moglko akiye kaiya mokna neingwa.

Ana Maria kungo demine orkwa mendugl mingi mundu kausi moglko, ana topo pond boglkwa yundre toindi Yesus kagle mina ende, ana bre yungo pagl koko ende tongwa. Ana deminemo wakai yungugl igle mundu kau sungwa.
Ba Yesus disaipelma mina suwarata kangiye Juda Iskariot, yagl i okuwo Yesus tekoglo kunda ikine onguno mina endinambuka yagle yegl dungwa,
“Sraglpre kungo demine orkwa mingi i nono topo K300 bogl indre, ana yomba kiuglgiunde meglkwa i tekune?”
Ye dungwa i yomba kiuglgiunde tenapre kaima ta dikrukwa. Sraglpre, ye kumbu kunogl yagl, ye eremogl Yesus disaipelma wagle monino gagl kine i-wangwa, ana ye nongura nina pre dungwa.
Ba Yesus yegl dungwa, “Ambu i kanwinge eriyo! Na goraglka enge maugl na sinaglkwa pre, kanwinge erimbi kungo demine orkwa i ake morano.
Ana yomba kiuglgiunde ene bogl engenge moraglkwa. Ba na ene bogl engenge ta moglkraglka.”
Yomba kande wagle Lasarus sigoramnedi ka dikeglkwa

Juda yomba merkinde pirkan erikwa, Yesus Betani kamun moglkwa. Yeglpre ye moglmara igle eingwa, ye pi Yesus keunde kana pre ta pikrikwa, taman, Lasarus akiye kana pre eingwa. Lasarus okuna goglko Yesus simange ikor endungwa.
Ikor endungwa ipre, pris kande wagle ye Lasarus ombugl sigoramnedi ka merkinde dikeglkwa.
Sraglpre Yesus eremogl Lasarus ikor endungwa ipre Juda yomba merkinde yombano kande wagle kindekondo ana Yesus wedi pirngi dingwa.
Yesus king mereyegl ende Jerusalem suna ongwa
Tangina yomba merkinde kaima Pasova mina wingwa ikra pirkwa, Yesus ende Jerusalem ungwa.
Ipre yomba endi palm yaundongo bukondi ake indre ana ye umara kanamnedi ende menda pindre ana ye mangre, oodi, dingwa,
Ana Yesus dongi nangigle kowo ta indre ana amedi mogltre endongwa, i kamambuno pepa mina dungwa pamere,

Komnaiye kana yene disaipelma wagle sragl i prapra pirpogl sikrikwa. Ba okuwo Yesus andigl ukor pi ende heven ongo, ana taragl prapra ye pre pepa muno beglko pangwa ikra ya te ye mina taragl prapra ta okuna ereteingwa ikra disaipelma wagle pirpogl singwa.
Ana Lasarus goglko kombuglo dra mina pandiglmara igle yomba mere Yesus bogl akiye meglko, ye agle dungo andigl ukor ongwa ikra pre ye kamo i aimande yomba boglo kugl wai dingwa.
Yomba mere pi Yesus umara konbo bange tengigl yeingwa sraglpre, ye kimagl orkwa i ye pirkwa pre.
Ana Parisi wagle ye yene ka i dipirkwa, “Ene kaniyo, nono taragl ta eramga kuno erekrukwa, sraglpre, yomba dumo koglkoglo ikra prapra pi Yesus omara mokomugl pi kondingwa i we.”
Grik yomba tau Yesus kanamnedi pirkwa
Pasova engemo yongo ana yomba God dembiye karaugl ere tena pre ende Jerusalem eingo, ana Grik yomba tau eimara pukamugl eingwa.
Ana Grik yomba ikra wu Pilip moglmara wingwa, ye Betsaida kamun Galili suna igle nem. Ana Grik yomba dingwa, “Yagl kande, no Yesus kanamnedi punga.”
Ana Pilip pi Andru ditongwa. Ana ye suwo-akiye pindre Yesus ditembrika.
Yesus di ikine ende tongwa, “Yomba Wam kangiye kande inambuka engemo erme magl orkwa.
Na ka kaima ene diteinga, wit mongo suwarata yange makan mina si goglkran ana mongo suwara i keunde yei panambuka. Ba mongo i makan mina goran ana ye mongo merkinde korambuka.
Yomba ta yene kor-moglkwa ipre munduwo panan ana okuwo kor-moglkwa i wau borambuka. Yomba ta makandle kor-moglkwa i moko tenan ana ye kor aimande morambuka i ye inambuka pre yongwa.
Yomba ta na konguna erambuka ye na enaglmara unambuka, yeglpre na moglmara igle na konguna yomba ye akiye morambuglka. Yomba ta na konguna erambuka ye kangiye kande Nina tenambuka.
Yesus yene gorambuka pre ka dungwa
“Erme na nomana yumbun dongwa ana na sragl we dinagle? Nina, ene akepledi naro, yumbun i na mina ukrano? Taman, yumbun ipre na winga, yeglpre yumbun unambuka enge i pra na inaglka.
Nina, ene etn kangin kande wu pene enano.” Ana okuwo heven imbo ka ta dungwa, “Na kangina ere i-kande ende kondiga, te kordagl ere i-kande endinaglka.”
Yomba merkinde igle andigl meglkwa ka i pirtre ana ye dingwa, “Kamun gurgagla dungwa.” Te yomba tau dingwa, “Angelo ka ta di ye tongwa.”
Ba Yesus yegl di yomba tongwa, “Ka dungwa i na pre tamanga ba yomba ene pre dungwa.
Erme God eremogl makandle yomba ka-tange tendre yumbu sinambuka enge yongwa, te makandle sugl moglkwa yagl kande i ka-tange tendre ana simenda endinambuka.
Te makandle na ake i-mitna endinaglkwa enge, yomba prapra imakai simbo nana mina unaglkwa.”
Ye ka dungwa i yene srambre ere giugogl gorambuka ipre dungwa.

Ana yomba merkinde di ikine endingwa, “No punga lo yegl dungwa pangwa i Mesaia ye kor aimande morambuka, ba sraglpre ene ka yegl dine, ‘Yomba Wam ye ake i-mitna imbo endinaglkwa?’ Yomba Wam i ye irane?”

Yesus di ikine endungwa, “Ken ambuglange i enge sungunagle keunde ene mina depai enambuka. Etne ene kenno-lam depangwa ipre engenge ambuglange igle mina wanmoglpai eriyo, te tamanan ana mim pond ere wu ene ake i-atne ende dinambiwo, te yomba ta ye mim mina suna wanmoglkwa i ye ende aglokra ongwa i yene ta kanpogl sikrikwa.
Ken ambuglange i ene mina yongwa pre i ene pirngi diyo, yegl erimbi ana ene ken ambuglange yombama moraglkwa.” Yesus ka yegl dikondo okuwo ye ende pindre, ana yomba ye kan dinaglmedi teke pangwa.
Juda yomba Yesus pirngi dikrikwa
Yesus kimagl merkinde orko kanigwa, ba yomba ye wedi pirngi dikrikwa.
Yegl erikwa i ana propet Aisaia ka dungwa ikra pai yungwa:

content.text: i ira pirngi dume? Te yomba
ira mina Yaglkande yombuglomo ombuno ditome?”

content: Mambuno ipre ye ana pirngi dinaglkwa kuno erekrukwa, sraglpre, propet Aisaia ka ta ama yegl dungwa,
Aisaia ka dungwa i sraglpre, ye Yesus ambuglangemo kangwa pre ana Yesus kamo dungwa.
Kaima, Juda yomba kande wagle tau Yesus pre pirngi dingwa. Ba ye pirngino i dinongugl endekrikwa, sraglpre, Parisi wagle eremogl ye makaino yungo mina simenda ende di poraglmedi pre kundugl geglkwa.
Te kangino yomba ake mitna endinaglkwa i pirkwa kande orkwa, ba God ye kangino ake mitna endinambedi pirkrikwa.
Yesus kamo i ka-tange yomba tenambuka
Yesus ka kande di yegl dungwa, “Yomba ta na wedi pre pirngi dinambuka ye na keunde pirngi dikrukwa, ba na diendungwa yagle i akiye pirngi dungwa.
Yomba ta na kanigwa i ombugl na diendungwa yagle i akiye kanigwa!
Na ken ambuglange yeglmere ende makandle winga. Yeglpre yomba ta na pirngi dinambuka, ye mim ormara suna ta moglkrambuka.
“Ba yomba ta na kanna pirtre ana na kanna i sika sikran, ana na ka-tange ye tekraglka. Na makandle winga i yomba yumbu sina pre ukrika, ba yomba ere-ina pre winga.
Yomba ta na moko nartre ana na kanna i pir ikran, ana yomba ta ye ka-tange tenambuka i pere moglkwa. Na ka dinga kamo i enge kande mina ka-tange tenambuka.
Ka i kaima sraglpre, nana pirmere mere ka ta dikrika, ba Nina na diendungwa yagle ka do dumere mere dinga te ama dinongugl endinaglka.
Ana na pirka ye ka dumara i kor aimande moraglkwa i dipene endungwa. Te na ka prapra dinga i Nina yegl do di narumere dinga.”

footnotes.text: Yomba eremogl Yesus ake plendi endi-prak mina pandraglkwa. Ana mambuno i mina God akeple dinan ana ye kaniye kande indre ende heven pindre mitna imbo kaima morambuka.
